custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, with 4 on hand and a hyphen in its part number.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425727 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425727-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425727-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window.
  • Have an active part, part B, with 4 on hand, so the lookup has a part it must still offer.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425727 PART B in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425727-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, and descriptions that start with the same text, so one search finds both.
    • How to do it: The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425727- and the descriptions start ZZAUTOTEST PL C425727 PART.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test, purchase order A, with one line for another part, not yet received.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO; pick any Vendor, type any existing part number in Part Number and pick it, type 1 in Quantity, click Add, then Save & Close. A purchase order made this way has no work order, so its page shows the Add Order Item button.
  • Start on purchase order A (Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then purchase order A).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A new line opens with a Part Number lookup.

Step 2:

  • Part B is offered.
  • No row for part A is offered: neither an inventory row with "Inventory Qty" nor a "Part Library" row.

Step 3:

  • The lookup shows part A's part number, written as it was saved (capitals and hyphens), followed by "is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.", in place of the offer to add the typed number.

Step 4:

  • Purchase order A still holds only its first line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R5: “Part lookup on a purchase order line does not return inactive parts.”
  • S9-R16: “When the number typed in a part lookup matches an inactive part at this location, the lookup does not offer to add it as a special order. It shows "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.", naming the inactive part's number. On technician charge-out, where a typed number is taken straight from the field, the field shows the same message as its error and the line cannot be saved.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Retired number typed in a part lookup | "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." | Shown in the lookup in place of the special order offer; on technician charge-out, error under the field”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "6.3 Typing the retired number in full". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • daily-03-p6-7-special-order-blocked.png

The design's own words:

  • “Typing greasetube in full does not offer it as a special order. The lookup shows "GREASETUBE is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." (S9-R16). If the part reached a line some other way, the system would refuse it with the same message (S9-R17).”

AUTOMATION: READY
